topic: Chacha Jee starts a diet, but the samosas have other plans.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ki Diet Aur Samosay

shots.narration: چچا نے سموسوں کو للکارا، آج سے صرف سلاد!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani dining room, sunny yellow walls, wooden table with a platter of golden samosas, 3D animated comedy film look, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha confidently pushes the samosa platter away with one finger.
shots.mood: Puffed chest, raised chin, comically determined eyebrows.

shots.narration: چاچی نے فوراً صحت والی پلیٹ حاضر کر دی۔
shots.scene: Same sunny dining room, samosa platter at the far end of the table, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi places a plate of cucumber slices and large lettuce leaves before Chacha.
shots.mood: Chachi's satisfied smile contrasts with Chacha's stiff, polite grin.

shots.narration: مگر سموسوں کی خوشبو سیدھی ناک تک پہنچ گئی۔
shots.scene: Close view across the dining table, steaming golden samosas in the foreground and untouched salad beside Chacha, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha leans his nose toward the steaming samosas.
shots.mood: Half-closed eyes, flared nostrils, helpless temptation.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، سلاد کو ذرا مزیدار بناتے ہیں!
shots.scene: Dining tabletop close-up, salad plate beside the samosa platter, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha folds a large lettuce leaf around one samosa.
shots.mood: Mischievous sideways glance and a smug little smile.

shots.narration: پپو نے سلاد کا نکلا ہوا کونا دیکھ لیا۔
shots.scene: Sunny dining table, Chacha holding a bulky lettuce parcel with a crisp triangular samosa corner protruding, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Pappu points at the exposed samosa corner.
shots.mood: Pappu wears a patient knowing smile; Chacha's eyes widen.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، بیٹا، یہ سلاد کی ہڈی ہے!
shots.scene: Same dining table, lettuce-wrapped samosa clearly visible in Chacha's hand, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha raises the lettuce parcel like a prized discovery.
shots.mood: Chacha looks utterly authoritative; Pappu raises one skeptical eyebrow.

shots.narration: چاچی آئیں تو ہڈی فوراً پلیٹ میں پہنچ گئی۔
shots.scene: Dining room with Chachi standing beside the table, salad plate directly beneath Chacha's hand, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha lowers the lettuce parcel onto his salad plate.
shots.mood: Chacha's exaggerated innocence, Pappu's restrained grin, Chachi's narrowed eyes.

shots.narration: چاچی بولیں، واہ، سلاد نے سموسہ پیدا کر دیا!
shots.scene: Close view of the salad plate with the hidden golden samosa, all three faces visible above the table, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi lifts the lettuce leaf off the samosa.
shots.mood: Triumphant raised eyebrow, Chacha's frozen guilty smile, Pappu's delighted expre

shots.narration: سموسے میرے، سلاد آپ کا؛ کل چہل قدمی ہوگی!
shots.scene: Wider dining room view, samosa platter beside Chachi, plain salad before seated Chacha, Pappu beside him, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi places a pair of walking shoes at Chacha's feet.
shots.mood: Chachi beams victoriously; Chacha stares open-mouthed at the shoes; Pappu grins.

episode.endHook: Kal Chacha Jee ki sair hogi, ya sair ka bahana?
episode.description: چچا جی نے پرہیز شروع کیا، مگر سموسوں کی خوشبو نے ارادہ ہلا دیا۔ پپو نے ترکیب پکڑ لی، اور چاچی جان نے آخری فیصلہ سنا دیا!
